optimizedDescription.value: Immutable language-agnostic code graph nodes, compact facts, deterministic lookups, scoped bindings, and typed relations.

optimizedContext.value:
# symbol-model

## Rules

### Core Entities
- `FileNode`: `path` (`workspace:relative/path`), `configRelativePath`, `language`, `contentHash`, `workspace`, optional `embedding: Float32Array`. Equality by `path`.
- `SpecNode`: `specId` (`workspace:package/topic`), `path`, `title`, `description`, `contentHash`, `content`, `dependsOn`, `workspace`. Equality by `specId`.
- `SymbolNode`: `id` (`filePath+kind+name+line+column`), `name`, `kind: SymbolKind`, `filePath`, 1-based `line`, 0-based `column`, optional `comment`.
- `DocumentNode`: searchable non-code file (`workspace:path`).

### Analysis & State
- Immutable compact `FileAnalysisDraft` & `FileAnalysis` (symbols, imports, binding/call facts, namespace context). Plain data, no AST/parser tree retention.
- Optional `ParserState` & `AdapterSessionState` for same-run deterministic caching.
- `IndexSession` & `SymbolIndex` bound lookups by relevant matches.

### Closed Enums & Relations
- `SymbolKind`: `function`, `class`, `method`, `variable`, `type`, `interface`, `enum`.
- `Relation`: `source`, `target`, `type: RelationType`, optional `metadata` (e.g. `stale: boolean`).
- `RelationType`: `IMPORTS` (v1.5), `DEPENDS_ON` (v1.5), `DEFINES` (v2), `EXPORTS` (v2), `CALLS` (v2), `CONSTRUCTS` (v2), `USES_TYPE` (v2), `EXTENDS` (v2), `IMPLEMENTS` (v2), `OVERRIDES` (v2), `COVERS_FILE` (v2+), `COVERS_SYMBOL` (v2+).

### Hierarchy & Imports
- `EXTENDS`: inherited type; `IMPLEMENTS`: contract symbol; `OVERRIDES`: concrete/replaced method. `OVERRIDES` persisted, not derived.
- `ImportDeclaration`: `localName`, `originalName`, `specifier`, `isRelative`, optional `kind` (`named`|`namespace`|`default`|`side-effect`|`dynamic`|`require`|`blank`).

### Scoped Bindings & Resolution
- Immutable facts for scopes (file/class/type/method/block), bindings (local, param, property, inherited, imported, alias), calls (caller, receiver, kind).
- Cycle detection on scope traversal: abort, return no result.
- No runtime reflection/interprocedural data flow modeling.
- Self-relations (`source === target`) dropped before persistence. Unresolved facts remain diagnostics, no speculative edges.

### Errors & Identity
- `SpecdCodeGraphError` extends `SpecdError`. Specific errors: `InvalidSymbolKindError`, `InvalidRelationTypeError`, `DuplicateSymbolIdError`, `StoreNotOpenError`.
- Structured logical symbols (workspace, module/package, owner, symbol space, simple name, member form) distinct from occurrences; canonical ref stable across line shifts.
- Case sensitivity follows language rules.
- Coverage facts track index status (`indexed`, `excluded`, `parse-failed`, etc.) + content hash.

## Constraints
- Structural equality for value objects (except deterministic `SymbolNode.id`).
- Closed `SymbolKind` and `RelationType`.
- Runtime dependency: `@specd/core`.
- `FileNode.embedding` deferred v2+.
- `COVERS_FILE`/`COVERS_SYMBOL` deferred v2+.
- `DEPENDS_ON` populated in v1.5 from `.specd-metadata.yaml`/`spec.md`.
